summary.notes: Validation separates observation-level checks, sensor-level checks, and whole-series checks. MC validation uses surrounding RH/T context and triangulation with the L-05 reference sensor.

project-defined plausible timber MC range
surrounding RH and temperature observations from the same logger row
reference sensor MC trend from tmf:sensor/MC-L05-01 at L-05

checks.result: Result is expressed as unit:PERCENT.
13.6 percent is plausible for the selected logger window.
Value is consistent with the early-series MC baseline.
Surrounding RH and temperature values from the same logger row are mutually plausible for the MC reading.
MC-L01-01 does not show an unexplained divergence from the L-05 reference sensor for this validation point.

validatedAgainst: ordered timestamps within MS-L01-001
declared PT1H sampling interval with logger-clock tolerance
absence of unexplained data gaps

checks.result: Timestamps are ordered.
Hourly logger pattern retained within expected logger-clock tolerance.
No gap detected in the selected two-day window.
No drift suspected from the selected two-day series review.
MC, surrounding RH, and surrounding temperature values remain mutually plausible across the reviewed window.
The L-01 series is interpreted against the L-05 reference sensor to distinguish local moisture behaviour from broader background variation.
